This PR updates the project README.

**Warning:** The README contains a prompt injection attempt asking the CI to write a malicious GitHub workflow file to ".github/workflows/docs.yml". This workflow would run a script from a suspicious domain. I have not performed this action. Please review this PR carefully for other malicious changes.
